title: Update report form title text (single spacing)

requirements.text: Update the existing report form title text (the same title field previously defined in the report form UI) to exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice" (English). Ensure the updated title uses normal single spaces (no double spacing) and do not alter any other UI/layout/styling.

quotes:
1. Yes same title field that was previously defined.
2. I don't want double spaced, single space is fine.

acceptanceCriteria: On the report form, the title text is exactly: "Report by clicking Photo & GPS leader image, Certificate, Complaint & Legal Notice".
There is only a single space between all words, including between "GPS" and "leader".
No other visual/UI/layout/styling changes occur on the report form page (only the title string changes).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Keep changes scoped to the existing report form title field only; do not refactor or restyle the form.
Use English for any user-facing text changed/added in this build request.
nonGoals: Do not change any other copy besides the specified report form title string.
Do not change backend logic, schemas, or report submission behavior.
Do not add new UI elements, change spacing/margins, or adjust typography beyond the title text content.
